project_name: Character model sheet, 4 turnaround views showing front, back, three-quarters, and side profile in one image of Harrison Croft, 30-year-old gritty Yorkshire endurance driver known as The Yorkshire Hammer. Short rugged brown buzz-crop hair, weathered stubble jaw, small scar on left cheekbone, resolute unyielding determined gaze. Wearing a heavy-duty reinforced Oxford navy-blue racing suit with diamond-quilted shoulder pads and durable carbon-fiber knuckles gloves, sturdy industrial racing boots. Holding a scuffed matte navy helmet with faded silver Union Jack stencil under his arm. Crisp cel-shaded anime style, thick black manga ink outlines, halftone Ben-Day dot shading, sharp geometric shadows, neutral grey studio background
